note: Family-run campground on the south edge of Maple Creek, a short walk from the historic downtown and about 20 minutes from Cypress Hills; shaded rows of full-service sites, two camp kitchens, a playground, cabins and rental RVs. Seasonal packages are also sold. Propane fire pits for rent; generators not allowed. --Claude
summary: Keep (private; $38/48/58 full service, cheapest electric C$38 passes the price gate; Google 4.4/154; 55 full-service sites per the operator's map). Seasonal packages sold but count unknown; no discouraging wording. Not waterfront confirmed (Maple Creek, a narrow creek, ~75 m west behind the office yard). Pin fine.
flags: PRICE GATE: pass. Cheapest real electric night C$38 (15-amp full service, homepage); 30-amp $48 (rates page lists 30/50 only), peak 50-amp $58. No mandatory per-person fee on RV sites; tax not stated.

LONG-STAY: rates page offers 'seasonal camping packages', with no seasonal price or site count posted. Nightly rates and a reservation form are posted; mid-summer imagery shows the rows mostly full but can't separate seasonal from nightly. Google 4.4 (154 reviews, place 'Willowbend Campground & Cabins'). No wording discouraging nightly guests. Not measurable; the reviewer may want a phone check if the seasonal share matters.
CABINS: 2 cabins, 2-3 rental RVs vs 55 RV sites - RV sites are the core, not an afterthought.
SEASON: stored year_round true ('Open year-round with partial winter services' in the old note) is not stated on any current page; left alone, unconfirmed.
SITES: count 55 added (operator map 2023); plus tent sites T1-T5 and overflow.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' confirmed. Maple Creek (a creek under 30 m wide) runs west and north of the campground; the map's 'Berm walkway path' and 'Creek' edge are beyond the E rows and the tent area, and the nearest RV rows sit ~75 m from the creek channel behind the office/shop yard on imagery.
